summary: Sprint M9 backend retest of body_id ← owner_body_id mirror bug. 16/17 pytests PASS. The primary iteration_22 bug is FIXED (POST with only owner_body_id='DIV-IND' now correctly returns body_id='DIV-IND'; PATCH force-syncs both directions; bcci_calendar_eligible flips both ways with bcci_approval). ONE new bug found by the exact scenario listed in the review request: the LEGACY reverse-fill (client sends body_id='DIV-GWL' with NO owner_body_id) still returns owner_body_id='MPCA'. Same class of defect as the original bug: VenueCreate.owner_body_id has default 'MPCA', so `data.get('owner_body_id') or data.get('body_id')` in _normalise_venue_payload short-circuits on the default before ever falling back to legacy body_id. All 5 seeded venues intact; filters ?owner_body_id=MPCA and ?bcci_approval=International return correct sets; 400 on unknown owner/manager body_id. All M9-prefixed test venues cleaned up.

critical.issue: LEGACY shape not honoured. When client sends only {body_id:'DIV-GWL'} (no owner_body_id), response has owner_body_id='MPCA' (not 'DIV-GWL' as required by the review-request contract). Root cause: routes/venues_grounds.py::_normalise_venue_payload line 73 → `owner = data.get('owner_body_id') or data.get('body_id') or 'MPCA'`. Because VenueBase.owner_body_id has default='MPCA', model_dump() always emits owner_body_id='MPCA' → the `or data.get('body_id')` fallback is dead. Same class of defect as the iteration_22 bug (Pydantic defaults masking the fallback). Fix: distinguish 'client explicitly sent MPCA' from 'MPCA was the default'; e.g. accept a `dict` from `payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` on the create/patch entry points instead of the full dump, or make owner_body_id/body_id Optional[str]=None in VenueBase and default them in the normaliser only.

action_items: Fix legacy-body_id back-fill in _normalise_venue_payload: use payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) at the /api/venues POST + PATCH entry points OR redeclare VenueBase.body_id / owner_body_id as Optional[str]=None so the `or` fallback in the normaliser actually fires. Currently the reverse mirror is still dead code because both fields carry a 'MPCA' default.

Optional hardening: after `owner = data.get('owner_body_id') or data.get('body_id') or 'MPCA'`, also detect the specific case where the caller passed body_id but not owner_body_id and honour that even when owner_body_id came in as the model default. Simplest: compare against `payload.model_fields_set` before dumping.
critical_code_review_comments: The M9 fix in _normalise_venue_payload correctly force-syncs body_id ← owner_body_id (forward direction), but the reverse fallback for legacy callers is still dead code for the same reason the original bug existed: Pydantic default 'MPCA' on owner_body_id makes the `or data.get('body_id')` unreachable. Move to `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` in the route handler OR drop the default in VenueBase.
bcci_calendar_eligible ↔ bcci_approval mirroring now works both ways on POST and PATCH — verified in tests.
PATCH still uses the full VenueCreate body (not a partial); any client-omitted field is silently reset to its Pydantic default. Pre-existing concern flagged in iteration_22; not regressed.

rca of the issue: POST /api/venues with legacy shape {body_id:'DIV-GWL'} → response owner_body_id='MPCA' (should be 'DIV-GWL'). The M9 fix replaced the old dead-code guards with `owner = data.get('owner_body_id') or data.get('body_id') or 'MPCA'`, but VenueBase.owner_body_id is declared `= 'MPCA'` in /app/backend/models.py:1238. Therefore payload.model_dump() ALWAYS emits owner_body_id='MPCA' when the client does not send it, the first `or` clause evaluates truthy, and the legacy body_id fallback never runs. The forward direction (owner set explicitly → body_id force-synced on line 75) works because it runs unconditionally, which is why the primary iteration_22 bug is fixed. Fix suggestions: (a) use `payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` in create_venue and update_venue so unspecified fields don't appear in `data`; or (b) redeclare both `body_id` and `owner_body_id` as `Optional[str] = None` in VenueBase and default them in the normaliser only.
